rule: The two tasks of posthog-opus-demo-four-2026-11-04 whose paired runs are published on the website (PR106936 'Member invitations', PR106672 'Metric UUIDs'), on their frozen nine-turn prompts. Chosen 2026-11-13 by which website runs exist and are complete, not by any outcome. Note the published runs set kronus's no-subagents flag, which disables the Agent tool and so the delegation handoff itself: these runs cannot be a like-for-like replication of those numbers, and that one setting has to differ.

verdicts.why: LemonField.Pure shows the inline rowError and adds errored styling to the email input.
SELF_INVITE_ERROR is flagged when the row matches the signed-in user's email.
Controls are disabled, but the generic 'Fix or remove highlighted rows' never mentions members.
The row email is trimmed and lowercased; member emails are lowercased.
ensureAllMembersLoaded runs on mount; own-email check depends only on user.
Field validation runs for every row before save, so the whole batch is rejected.
Field ValidationError on target_email with code existing_member; tests assert code and attr.
Known 400 codes are caught and toasted; other errors are rethrown.
ensureAllMembersLoaded likely skips already-loaded data, so no real refresh happens.

grade.note: c3's disabled reason is generic. c9 calls 'ensure' rather than forcing a reload, so a stale list probably stays unflagged.
